description: Source code for a Data Encryption Unit driver specific to the Danube chip, including hardware initialization, chip version detection, and utility functions.

methods.name: endian_swap
methods.description: Returns the input value unchanged; function is not used.

methods.name: input_swap
methods.description: Swaps byte order of input if chip version is below 1.4.

methods.name: aes_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes AES hardware by setting control register bits.

methods.name: des_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes DES hardware by setting control register bits.

methods.name: chip_version
methods.description: Detects chip version by reading chip ID register and sets a flag accordingly.
